integrity: Closed finite-sum proof and exact-rational reproducibility code; no independent external audit or publication certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for initially polarized complete bipartite binary median dynamics with per-camp constant positive Poisson rates and self-retaining ties. Arbitrary initial states or networks, response-time distributions, and alternative tie rules are outside scope. Literature-priority uncertainty remains despite source comparisons.
title: Exact polarized-biclique median fixation and the odd–even winner bias
